title: Fail-closed P1 owner and observation-map admission contract
question: Can the existing T-054/T-059/T-061 owner order and four-stage observation map be made fail-closed and resumable without changing the research methods or admitting a synthetic owner?
method: Preserve the established T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 observation-first inverse methods, owner order, stopped-loop rules and promotion firewalls.
Hash-pin the R-449 owner-leakage boundary, T-059 inverse contract, R-470 source-provenance boundary and Lean project authorities.
Implement a structural admission state machine over the nine ordered owner slots, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, candidate-neutral estimand, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.
Run independent order/set checks and hostile mutations; permit synthetic fixtures to test only the contract and never production scoring.
Cross-check the Boolean fail-closed predicates in Lean without supplying a source owner or physical interpretation.
decision_scope: T0 finite model-consistency/admission tooling; no physical owner, candidate score, holdout prediction or tier action
decision_scope_note: This is an additive resumability contract, not a replacement for either research lane and not another finite dynamics table.
finding: The current packet is deterministically EMPTY_OWNER_ARTIFACT with zero admitted candidates. A complete synthetic packet is deterministically CONTRACT_TEST_ONLY_COMPLETE and cannot reach scoring or prospective validation. Missing source hash, any owner slot, any earlier map stage, the immutable scorer or the prospective holdout blocks admission.
decision_reason: R-449 identified the exact owner/proof leakage boundary and R-470 stopped generic parser-source intake, but their boundaries were not yet an executable transition contract. R-471 adds that contract so future owner input can be admitted or rejected reproducibly while the established methods remain unchanged.
evidence_level: T0 exact contract state machine with primary 24/24, independent 18/18, hostile 18/18 (14/14 mutations rejected), integrated 10/10 and Lean R471 PASS
assumptions: R-449, the T-059 inverse contract and R-470 remain the controlling authorities.
A source hash identifies bytes but does not establish physical identity.
The nine owner slots and four map stages are existing contracts, not a new dynamics choice.
Synthetic fixtures are suitable only for testing the admission predicate.
Lean verifies the finite Boolean firewall and not a physical theorem.
missing_assumptions: A versioned source-owned generator or transfer, state, physical projection and time boundary.
The heat-root incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current intertwiner and production one-use q ledger.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map with covariance, nuisance, scorer and prospective holdout.
Uniform regulator/volume/phase/limit estimates and a QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity correspondence.
boundary: No source-owned dynamics or observation map is admitted. No finite mobility table, physical-empty sign, Reading-H stationarity, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin or mass-gap conclusion follows. Existing methods, owner order and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
next_action: Keep the owner branch at EMPTY_OWNER_ARTIFACT. Request the versioned physical-owner validity/interpolation, common time standard, detector-to-geocenter and timing-uncertainty contract for T-061, and resume the unchanged T-054 owner-level Q3LOCK queue. Do not score until a real non-synthetic packet fills every slot and all four map stages in order.
stop_or_redesign: If no new owner artifact hash exists, keep the branch parked and do not create an equivalent finite mobility table.
If an owner packet is partial or a map stage is missing, remain fail-closed at the corresponding state.
If a synthetic or retrospective packet is used, issue a new contract-test record and do not promote it to scoring.
If a future owner changes the contract fields, create a new version rather than mutating this record.

adversarial_review.check: Could a finite comparator or parser be promoted to a source owner?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: all nine slots and a non-synthetic source hash are required.

adversarial_review.check: Could a complete fixture enter scoring?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: synthetic provenance is contract-test-only in both lanes and Lean.

adversarial_review.check: Could F_lim, F_eff or F_obs be used while F_reg is missing?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the first missing ordered stage blocks later admission.

adversarial_review.check: Could a disclosed or mutable target count as prospective evidence?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: immutable scorer and prospective holdout are separate required flags.

adversarial_review.check: Could the contract replace the existing research methods?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: all method-preservation flags are asserted and no claim/tier/gate changes.
